main_body: cottage building with tiled roof and timber-framed plaster front wall
top_band: terracotta tiled roof slope, rows 2-43 (lightest at the ridge rows 3-12, stepping down to darker red-brown at the eave rows 41-43)
evidence: Rows 2-43 show the full top/front-sloping surface of the tiled roof seen from above with a chimney opening on top (row 1); row 42-43 forms the distinct eave front edge overhanging the recessed wall, casting an eave shadow on rows 44-45 of the plaster front face (rows 44-78). Door and window are recessed into frames.

style.evidence: The roof has a 6-step terracotta ramp with individual tile articulation and speckle, plaster walls have multi-tone grain and eave shadow, and outlines use dark brown/maroon material tones. Slightly simpler framing geometry and larger window glass planes than the Beodeul reference, but overall shading craft, texture grain, and material-toned outlines hold up well.
